title: The Location filter offers only the user's locations
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Use an organization with two locations, location A and location B.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, closed at location A, closed this month.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 2, for internal customer A, closed at location B, closed this month.
  • Sign in as a user with 'Reports — Page Access' and access to location A only.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports > Internal Work Orders.
  2. Open the Location filter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 is listed; work order 2 is not.

Step 2:

  • Only location A is offered.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11766 (Story 9, Reports, dashboard and exports)

  • S9-R16: “The report, both tabs and the export run through the accessible-workplace scope every report uses (SV-9116): a user sees the locations they have access to, the Location filter offers only those, and the By technician numbers are computed on that scope.”
